liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: John Selden’s manuscript, now lost (known from Twysden’s variants)
liebermann.notes: John Selden's manuscript of the London Leges Anglorum (see Lond), containing Leges Henrici and Henry I's London charter, known from variants noted by Twysden (in Wheloc's Archaionomia 1644); it stands closest to K.

entries.text_de: John Selden’s Codex, Hn, u. S. 547, mit Hn Lond, u. S. 524, enthaltend, woraus Twysden10 Varianten notirte. Die Hs. giebt den Text der Leges Anglorum s. XIII. in. Lond. coll. (s. o. Lond) und steht K zunächst11.
entries.text_en: John Selden’s codex, containing Hn, below, p. 547, with Hn Lond, below, p. 524, from which Twysden10 noted variants. The MS gives the text of the Leges Anglorum s. XIII. in. Lond. coll. (see above, Lond) and stands closest to K11.
